namedContractTerm.term: the evaluation as-of is part of every reference identity
namedContractTerm.what: evaluateExpression carries context.asOf down the tree, and a metric, term, ledger or event reference resolved under it queries at that as-of. A fact stored as NOT_AS_OF_SPECIFIC therefore does NOT satisfy a reference evaluated as of a date, and vice versa.
namedContractTerm.why: the alternative is for the runtime to decide, on its own, that a fact with no date is good enough for a dated question. That is the implicit as-of assumption this phase exists to remove.
namedContractTerm.consequence: Phase 5 must tag each fact with the as-of it is true at. The dependency manifest already states the exact as-of each reference will ask for, so a supplier never has to guess.
namedContractTerm.failureDirection: closed - a mismatch is MISSING (NEEDS_INPUT), never a substituted number
namedContractTerm.acknowledgedCost: a single approved snapshot is not reusable across evaluation dates unless its facts carry the matching as-of or the caller names the LATEST_ON_OR_BEFORE mode
